purpose: Managed work, transition guards, durability, notifications and completion.
use: Managed work: immediately open/publish required TKT-NNNN-subject tickets before effects; separate distinct objectives and progress; report transitions.
semantic_conditions: G0 may stay ephemeral and G1 may use existing issue, PR or version control evidence; G2-G4 need managed facts.
mandatory_preconditions: Classified governance level, effective scope and expected prior ticket state/revision.
postconditions_verification: Each required opening and transition immediately published/read back; unique increasing ticket headings and pertinent progress; completion gate satisfied.
